s.g: An animal of the family Bovidae (such as the antelope, cattle, goat, and sheep).
Of, relating to, belonging to, or characteristic of animal of the family Bovidae (such as the antelope, cattle, goat, and sheep).
(not comparable) Of, relating to, or characteristic of cattle, buffaloes, or bison.
(not comparable) Belonging to the subfamily Bovinae.
An animal of a family, subfamily, tribe, or genera including cattle, buffaloes and bison.
(often specifically) An animal of the subfamily Bovinae.
(UK, slang) Violence, especially that associated with youth gangs.

bovvered.f: simple past and past participle of bovver
